name: is-an-image-url
description: Check whether a URL points to an image, by its file extension or else by the Content-Type of the response, with a command line tool. Zero dependencies, TypeScript, ESM and CommonJS, Node 20+.
author: Mark Rogers (https://www.markdavidrogers.com)

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:dist
scripts.test:dist: node --test test/golden/golden.test.js test/unit/api.test.js test/functional/is-an-image-url.test.js test/cli/cli.test.js test/package/shape.test.js
scripts.coverage: npm run build && c8 --check-coverage --lines 95 --branches 90 --exclude-after-remap --include "src/**" --reporter text --reporter lcov node --test test/golden/golden.test.js test/unit/api.test.js test/functional/is-an-image-url.test.js test/cli/cli.test.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check && npm test
